description: This file contains unit tests for utility functions related to credits calculation and normalization within a data management dashboard project, including tests for environment variable handling, numerical conversions, and data shape validation.

methods.name: getCreditsPerUsd
methods.description: Returns the number of credits per USD, defaulting to 20000, or reading from environment variable if set.

methods.name: usdToCredits
methods.description: Converts a USD amount to credits based on the current credits per USD rate, handling string inputs and invalid values.
